papers.title_en: From Digital Human Interactions to Physics-Based Humanoid Skills: Physics-Grounded Post-Training of Interaction Generators
papers.authors: Kerui Chen, Jianrong Zhang, Kai Lv, Hehe Fan
papers.evidence: 基于物理的人形机器人交互生成器后训练
papers.tldr: 双人形交互生成常依赖物理跟踪策略将数字参考动作转为可执行轨迹，但跟踪能力有限且成功执行未必物理合理或忠实。为此，DIGHT协同自适应耦合数字人交互生成器与人形跟踪策略：在仿真中执行文本条件候选，从跟踪误差、摩擦、漂浮和接触力反馈构建物理偏好，并用物理解耦扩散DPO对齐生成器，再微调跟踪器。实验显示，该方法提升生成动作物理合理性，并实现更可靠、忠实的人形交互，为数字交互到物理技能提供新范式。
papers.abstract_en: Recent methods have made promising progress in generating interactions between two humanoids, largely relying on physics-based tracking policies to convert digital reference motions into executable trajectories. However, limited tracking capabilities restrict the range of reference motions that can be successfully executed, reducing data utilization. Moreover, even successful tracking does not guarantee physically plausible responses or faithful realization of the intended interactions. In this paper, we introduce DIGHT, a co-adaptive framework that couples a Digital human Interaction Generator with a Humanoid Tracking policy. Our DIGHT first executes multiple text-conditioned interaction candidates in simulation using a fixed tracker. It then constructs physics-grounded preferences from the resulting rollouts, covering both general executability and interaction fidelity. Rather than collapsing these signals into a single scalar reward for candidate ranking, we align the pretrained generator using physics-decoupled diffusion direct preference optimization (DPO), preserving criterion-specific supervision without differentiating through the simulator. To improve executability, preference pairs are derived from tracking error, friction, and floating. Additionally, to improve interaction fidelity, we propose to incorporate force feedback from simulator as a measure of contact fidelity and construct preferences over contact occurrence, location, duration, and force magnitude. The aligned generator then supplies reference motions for fine-tuning the tracker, improving compatibility between generation and physical execution. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach not only improves the physical plausibility of generated motions but also enables more reliable and faithful humanoid interactions in simulation.

papers.title_en: Test-Time Compute for Humanoid Behavior Foundation Models
papers.authors: Weiji Xie, Junsong Wu, Zibo Zhou, Yueru Chen, Xingyi Wang, Zhenhua Xiong, Weinan Zhang, Chenjia Bai
papers.evidence: 面向人形行为基础模型运动执行的测试时计算
papers.tldr: 人形行为基础模型（BFM）动作强，但 loco-manipulation 需高全身位置精度，存在系统性指令-执行偏差。为此提出测试时指令优化 TTCO，通过闭环仿真采样搜索适配 BFM 的输入指令，使执行轨迹更接近目标且无需重训练。在 AMASS 上三个 BFM 中，仿真平均全局身体位置误差降低 79–84%，并给出测试时算力扩展的近似最优策略。TTCO 还能从机器人轨迹生成 BFM 专属动作标签，用于训练高层策略并支持跨 BFM 复用演示。
papers.abstract_en: Humanoid Behavior Foundation Models (BFMs) can execute impressive motions, but downstream applications such as loco-manipulation demand high whole-body positional accuracy. Existing BFMs suffer from a systematic command-execution gap, where executed motions deviate from desired ones. We show that additional test-time compute can improve execution without retraining the BFM. First, we introduce Test-Time Command Optimization (TTCO), which adapts the input command to the specific BFM to produce an executed trajectory closer to the desired motion. TTCO finds such commands by sampling-based optimization through closed-loop simulations of the BFM and robot dynamics. Across three BFMs on the AMASS dataset, TTCO reduces mean global body-position error by 79-84% in simulation. Second, we analyze test-time compute scaling and derive an approximate compute-optimal strategy that can sustain performance gains as the compute budget increases. Third, TTCO can generate BFM-specific action labels from recorded robot trajectories without requiring the original teleoperation body-motion commands. Simulation and real-robot experiments show that these labels are effective for training high-level loco-manipulation policies. This method also supports reusing existing demonstrations across BFMs.

papers.title_en: Modeling and Control of a Rigid-soft Hybrid-link Humanoid Robot
papers.authors: Zewen He, Taiki Ishigaki, Ko Yamamoto
papers.evidence: 针对人形机器人的逆运动学与柔顺优化控制
papers.tldr: 刚柔混合连杆人形机器人兼具刚体与柔性元件，可利用被动柔性储能与缓冲冲击，但运动设计与控制仍具挑战。本文采用分段常应变(PCS)模型刻画柔性结构连续变形，提出基于逆运动学与柔顺优化的混合连杆控制框架。通过前向动力学仿真验证站立、跳跃与行走；并搭建带叶簧假肢腿的双足机器人实验平台，用动作捕捉测量假肢变形，实验验证双支撑与单支撑站立平衡控制。
papers.abstract_en: Physical flexibility plays a significant role not only in human motions but also in robot motions. For example, a humanoid robot with passive and flexible elements, which can be regarded as a rigid--soft hybrid-link system, has the advantages of storing energy and mitigating impact in a dynamic motion. However, the motion design and control of a hybrid-link system are challenging to achieve and have only been discussed in the literature. In this study, we propose the framework of inverse kinematics and compliance optimization-based control for a hybrid-link humanoid system that represents the continuous deformation of a flexible structure using the piece-wise constant strain (PCS) model. The proposed method was validated using forward dynamics simulations for standing, jumping, and walking motions. Then, we built an experimental setup using a biped humanoid robot with leaf-spring type prosthesis leg, in which the prosthesis deformation was measured by a motion capture system. Using this setup, we experimentally validated the proposed method for standing balance control in both double- and single-support cases.

papers.title_en: TRACE: Efficient Transfer Learning for Neural Whole-Body Control Across Humanoid Embodiments
papers.authors: Qingyu Lan, Zhihao Tian, Zifan Wang, Junwei Liang
papers.evidence: 面向人形跨本体的神经全身控制迁移
papers.tldr: 人形行为基础模型虽能实现多样全身控制，但受运动学与动力学差异影响，迁移到新本体十分困难。TRACE 在保留预训练运动表征的同时，通过注入运动学先验、对齐关节标称动力学并蒸馏编码器，结合低秩强化学习与两阶段课程，实现高效跨本体适配。仅用 1000 万帧运动数据、单卡约 8 小时训练，便把 SONIC 从 Unitree G1 迁移到 H2，在 67953 条评测动作上取得 96.08% 成功率，训练成本不到从头训练的 0.1%。
papers.abstract_en: Humanoid behavior foundation models (BFMs) enable diverse whole-body control, but adapting a pretrained controller to a new embodiment remains challenging because of kinematic and dynamic mismatch. We present TRACE, a framework for efficient cross-embodiment adaptation that preserves pretrained motion representations while specializing feedback control to the target robot.TRACE first injects kinematic priors into input and output projection layers and aligns nominal joint dynamics to reduce embodiment mismatch and support stable fine-tuning. It then combines encoder distillation with low-rank reinforcement learning on a compact, quality-screened motion set, using a two-phase curriculum to establish stable tracking before refining difficult motions. We apply TRACE to transfer SONIC from Unitree G1 to Unitree H2 using 10 million motion frames and approximately eight hours of training on a single RTX PRO 6000 GPU, at less than 0.1% of the GPU-hour cost of training SONIC from scratch. The adapted controller achieves 96.08\% success on 67,953 evaluation motions under a height-scaled tracking criterion. Real-robot demonstrations span dynamic motion tracking and whole-body teleoperation, with collected demonstrations supporting downstream vision-language-action policy post-training. These results demonstrate practical reuse of a pretrained humanoid controller across robots with different body scales and dynamics.

papers.title_en: Contact-UAN: Unsupervised Actuator Networks as a Residual World Model for Humanoid Control
papers.authors: Nolan Fey, Khai Nguyen, Yash Prabhu, Gabriel B. Margolis, Pulkit Agrawal
papers.evidence: 修正执行器动力学的人形sim-to-real残差世界模型
papers.tldr: 人形策略从仿真迁移到硬件时常丢失力交互，导致力矩效率、负载调节与抗冲击能力不足，根源在执行器 sim-to-real 差距。Contact-UAN 作为残差世界模型，保留仿真器物理先验，仅修正执行器动力学，并用接触一致重放对齐硬件轨迹。它仅靠本体感知推断支撑脚位姿，避免残差模型学习重置伪影。仅用6.5分钟真实行走数据训练，即实现运行力矩降低20%、力跟踪误差降低43%，并支持阻抗控制与鲁棒跳跃。
papers.abstract_en: Humanoid policies trained in simulation can transfer qualitatively to hardware while failing to transfer the force interactions learned during training, compromising torque efficiency, load regulation, and robustness to impacts. This failure can arise from actuator sim-to-real gaps because forces depend on actuator torques. We introduce Contact-UAN, a residual world model that preserves a simulator's physics priors while correcting actuator dynamics to align simulated rollouts with recorded hardware rollouts. For humanoid motion with contact, this requires contact-consistent replay: if hardware playback in simulation begins with misaligned contact wrenches, the residual model learns to correct reset artifacts rather than actuator discrepancies. Using only onboard proprioception, Contact-UAN infers the simulator-side stance-foot pose needed to initialize replay with consistent contact forces. We show that a UAN trained on 6.5 minutes of real-world walking data generalizes to tasks that benefit from accurate force and impulse regulation and produces policies that transfer seamlessly to the real world, yielding 20% lower running torque, 43% lower force-tracking error, extreme compliance, accurate impedance control, and dynamic, robust jumps.

papers.title_en: Safe Reinforcement Learning with Receding-Horizon Safety Critic and Differentiable Action Shields
papers.authors: Siwei Ju, Jan Peters, Oleg Arenz
papers.evidence: 结合滚动时域安全评论家与可微动作屏蔽的约束安全强化学习
papers.tldr: 机器人强化学习中的安全失效常跨多步累积，而非瞬间发生，仅靠马尔可夫假设难以前瞻预警。本文学习递推时域安全评论家，预测未来时域内状态是否保持非终止，并用分类、CBF时序一致性与平滑正则训练，结合CVaR集成应对不确定性。进而推导闭式可微CBF安全过滤器，在PPO中加入预期损失以缓解策略-过滤器失配。四足仿真中，该方法在动作噪声、外部扰动与地形迁移下减少灾难性失败，同时保持竞争力回报。
papers.abstract_en: Despite the Markov assumption, safety failures in robot reinforcement learning rarely occur instantaneously; they typically emerge over several steps as the policy enters unfamiliar states under disturbances and domain shift. We address this limitation by learning a receding-horizon safety critic that predicts whether a state will remain non-terminating over the next receding horizon, enabling anticipatory detection of impending locomotion failures. The critic is trained from rollout-derived horizon labels with a composite objective that combines horizon classification, control-barrier-function-inspired temporal consistency, and smoothness regularization, and we aggregate an ensemble of critics with a conservative Conditional Value at Risk estimate to account for uncertainty. Building on the learned critic, we derive a closed-form, differentiable CBF-style safety filter that minimally modifies the policy action to improve predicted safety, and integrate it into PPO with an anticipation loss to reduce policy-filter mismatch during training. In simulated quadruped locomotion, our method improves robustness under action noise, external perturbations, and terrain shifts, reducing catastrophic failures while maintaining competitive returns.

papers.title_en: A Nonlocal Stochastic Optimal Control with Elliptic-Type Smoothing
papers.authors: Stefana-Lucia Anita, Luca Di Persio
papers.evidence: 非局部随机最优控制的庞特里亚金型最大值原理
papers.tldr: 本文研究控制通过椭圆平滑算子 S=(I-Δ)⁻¹ 作用的非局部随机最优控制问题，状态由受控扩散的分布刻画，等价于含 Su 系数的受控 Fokker-Planck 方程。作者用变分直接法证明最优控制存在，并借助 S 的精细性质与尖峰变分推导 Pontryagin 型最大值原理。所得结果给出最优控制的逐点最小化规则。该工作为非局部随机控制提供了可验证的最优性条件，并讨论其在种群动力学中的意义。
papers.abstract_en: We study a nonlocal stochastic optimal control problem in which the control acts through the elliptic smoothing operator $\mathcal{S}=(I-Δ)^{-1}$ on $\mathbb{R}^d$. The state is described by the law of a controlled diffusion, equivalently by a controlled Fokker-Planck equation with coefficients depending on $\mathcal{S}u$. We prove the existence of an optimal control by the direct method in the calculus of variations. We then derive a Pontryagin-type maximum principle by spike variations, relying on sharp properties of the operator $\mathcal{S}$. The result yields a pointwise minimisation rule for the optimal control. We discuss the meaning of the optimal control problem in the case of population dynamics.

papers.title_en: LAIR-Net: Leaky Alignment-Impulse Residual Networks for Tabular Regression
papers.authors: Rahul Goswami, Aryan Bhambu, Bittu Karmakar
papers.evidence: 通过泄漏残差过渡将浅层学习锚混入隐藏状态的残差网络
papers.tldr: 深度随机模型通常固定隐层参数、只学习闭式读出，并通过堆叠随机变换增加深度，却缺乏对隐状态演化的目标感知控制。为此，作者提出LAIR-Net，以泄漏残差转移把浅层可学习锚点混入每个隐状态。理论上给出输入扰动敏感度的深度一致界，并通过受控模拟把增益归因于锚点而非递归或容量。在23个表格回归基准上，它在8种随机网络和12种传统模型中取得最佳平均排名，且性能关联非线性结构与噪声水平。
papers.abstract_en: Deep randomized models fix hidden-layer parameters through random initialization and learn only closed-form readouts, typically adding depth by stacking random trans formations without target-aware control of hidden-state evolution. We propose LAIR Net, the Leaky Alignment-Impulse Residual Network, which mixes a shallow learned anchor into each hidden state through a leaky residual transition. We derive a depth uniform bound on input-perturbation sensitivity and use controlled simulations to attribute gains over a randomized baseline to the anchor rather than recursion or added capacity. Benefits emerge when a nonlinear target structure is learnable at the available noise level and diminish for nearly linear targets or dominant noise. Across 23 benchmark datasets, LAIR-Net achieves the best average rank among eight randomized networks and twelve conventional models, with relative performance associated with the same nonlinear-structure and noise quantities identified in simulation.

papers.title_en: Generative Neural Retargeting for Human-to-Robot Dexterous Manipulation
papers.authors: Dechen Gao, Yue Yang, Ben Abbatematteo, Nathan Godwin, Pengcheng Wang, Roger Boldu, Steven Man, Zhiyang Dou, Chuan Qin, Sho Nakagome, Eric Whitmire
papers.evidence: 强化学习与MPC用于人到机器人的动作重定向
papers.tldr: 人类演示是学习灵巧操作的可扩展数据源，但人机本体差异使人类动作无法直接部署到机器人。逆运动学重定向忽略动力学，强化学习与采样MPC虽能生成可行动作，却样本效率低、超参敏感且难以扩展。为此提出生成式神经重定向GNR，假设可行轨迹集中于跨演示共享的低维流形，用流匹配模型以人类运动为条件直接采样轨迹。GNR仅需MPC 8.5%的样本即达56.20%成功率，远超MPC的27.20%；结合real-to-sim数据引擎，构建含密集接触力标签的223k演示、3.3k物体几何数据集。
papers.abstract_en: Human demonstrations are a scalable data source for learning dexterous manipulation, but the embodiment gap prevents human motion from being executed directly on robots. Inverse kinematics (IK) retargets human motion to robots efficiently but ignores dynamics, often producing infeasible motions. Reinforcement learning (RL) and sampling-based model predictive control (MPC) are commonly employed to yield dynamically feasible motions, but both are sample-inefficient and sensitive to hyperparameters. RL suffers from costly and unstable training and tedious reward engineering; MPC avoids policy optimization, yet retargets each trajectory in isolation, and solving one does not make the next easier. Sampling cost grows rapidly with dataset size and task difficulty. We hypothesize that dynamically feasible trajectories concentrate near a low-dimensional manifold shared across demonstrations, so that retargeting can be reduced to sampling from that manifold, conditioned on human motion, rather than solving a fresh optimization problem for every demonstration. We propose \textbf{Generative Neural Retargeting} (GNR), which uses a flow matching model to sample feasible trajectories. GNR outperforms MPC with only $8.5\%$ of the samples required by MPC, achieving a success rate of $56.20\%$ compared to $27.20\%$ for MPC. GNR can be used for scalable and efficient retargeting of large-scale, long-horizon, and millimeter precision human demonstrations: by applying GNR within a real-to-sim data engine, we produce a dexterous manipulation dataset with dense contact-force labels, spanning $223$k demonstrations and $3.3$k object geometries.

papers.title_en: Composable Dynamics for Cooperative Humanoids: A RoboCompiler Extension
papers.authors: Mehdi Heydari Shahna, Jouni Mattila
papers.evidence: 面向协作人形控制的编译动力学与约束曲率
papers.tldr: 物理连接的人形机器人需一致动力学，以协调内部执行器、机器人间力与变化支撑。该工作扩展 RoboCompiler，按成员组装刚体、运动执行器与反射转子惯量的降阶动力学，并编译雅可比与解析约束曲率，获得满足功率恒等式的显式科氏因子。两级降阶保留可复用模型并组合支撑与手部连接，局部惯性更新秩至多六，约束力旋量对执行器力矩仿射。八种构型264个可行状态中归一化加速度误差低于1.6e-10；MuJoCo环舞骨盆RMS误差0.73 mm，完成20次支撑模式切换的侧步。
papers.abstract_en: Physically connected humanoids need consistent dynamics for internal actuator loops, inter-robot forces, and changing ground supports. We extend RoboCompiler with member-wise dynamics assembly, compiling reduced dynamics from rigid bodies, moving actuator parts, and reflected rotor inertias. Compiled body Jacobians and analytic constraint curvature yield an explicit Coriolis factor satisfying the power identity for floating-base quasi-velocities. A two-level reduction retains reusable robot models while composing their supports and hand connections; local inertial updates have rank at most six, and prescribed-acceleration constraint wrenches are affine in actuator efforts. These interfaces support actuator-aware tracking, coupled force allocation, payload updates, and support-mode switching for five hand-linked humanoids. Across 264 feasible states in eight humanoid configurations, normalised acceleration discrepancies remain within $1.6\!\times\!10^{-10}$ against a hard-constraint reference and $1.4\!\times\!10^{-10}$ against a compiler-independent reference; MuJoCo simulations achieve 0.73~mm root-mean-square (RMS) pelvis error in the ring dance and complete side steps through 20 support-mode changes.

papers.title_en: Chunk-wise Model-based Policy Optimization
papers.authors: Weixi Song, Donglin Wang, Yong-Lu Li
papers.evidence: 用可微分分块世界模型训练分块actor的基于模型策略优化
papers.tldr: 基于模型的强化学习虽样本效率高，但现有规划或梯度更新方法常受循环复合误差、推理延迟和BPTT不稳定困扰。本文提出分块式基于模型策略优化，用分块世界模型作为可微训练期评估器，直接优化分块策略，无需循环调用模型。通过世界模型与策略协同分块预测，可在单次前向中生成H步假想轨迹并优化价值展开，避开BPTT。在HumanoidBench 19个高维人形任务及真实四足/双足行走上验证了有效性。
papers.abstract_en: Model-based reinforcement learning has shown superior sample efficiency by leveraging the learned latent dynamics either in the form of derivative-free planning/imagined rollout training or dynamics gradient-based policy updates. While these approaches achieve comparatively fast learning, they all suffer, to varying degrees, from issues of recurrent compounding errors, high inference-time latency, and instability in backward propagation through time (BPTT). In this work, we propose a model-based RL approach that uses the chunk world model as a differentiable training-time evaluator to optimize the chunk actor without recurrent model invocation. Through the collaborative chunk-wise prediction of the world model and policy, we can generate H-step hypothetical rollouts in a single forward pass and directly optimize value expansion, avoiding the costly and unstable BPTT. We evaluate our method on 19 challenging high-dimensional humanoid tasks from HumanoidBench and deploy our method to the real-world for quadruped bipedal walking. Project Website: https://song-wx.github.io/cmpo.github.io/

papers.title_en: CFG-Policy: Unified Diffusion Policy Learning Framework via Classifier-free Guidance
papers.authors: Shutong Ding, Zhaoyang Liu, Yimiao Zhou, Jingya Wang, Jiayuan Gu, Ye Shi
papers.evidence: 面向机器人RL后训练的统一扩散策略学习框架
papers.tldr: 扩散策略在机器人控制与VLA模型中表现突出，但RL后训练会削弱行为多样性，直接微调也可能破坏预训练能力。CFG-Policy提出统一即插即用框架，将探索与利用拆分为两个生成策略，并在采样时用无分类器引导融合其分数或速度场。在线RL冻结探索分支维持多样性，利用分支学习奖励；离线到在线则冻结预训练利用分支，由可训练分支引导组合行为。5个MuJoCo和4个RoboTwin任务上，保留RL目标提升QSM、QVPO与Flow-SDE+PPO性能。
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion policies are increasingly used in robotic control and manipulation, vision-language-action models, and world-model-based agents. Their ability to represent multimodal action distributions offers rich opportunities for exploration in reinforcement learning (RL). However, optimizing diffusion policies with RL can reduce the behavioral diversity and further limit their exploration capability. In RL post-training, directly fine-tuning a pretrained policy may also disrupt its acquired capabilities, while action-space residuals may lack the expressive power for multimodal exploration. Together, these issues reveal a common challenge across online and offline-to-online diffusion RL: improving task performance while retaining the behavioral diversity and capabilities needed for continued adaptation. We introduce CFG-Policy, a unified, plug-and-play framework that separates exploration and exploitation into two generative policies and combines their score or velocity fields during sampling through classifier-free guidance. For online RL, a frozen exploration branch sustains behavioral diversity while an exploitation branch learns from task rewards; for offline-to-online RL, a pretrained exploitation branch remains frozen while a trainable branch steers the composed behavior. CFG-Policy preserves the underlying RL objectives and improves performance with QSM and QVPO on 5 MuJoCo tasks and with Flow-SDE+PPO on 4 RoboTwin manipulation tasks. Project page is at https://zhy-liu.github.io/cfg-policy-page.

papers.title_en: Mixing Regularization for Average-Reward $Q$-Learning and $Q$-Planning
papers.authors: Julien Roger, Sam Bodmer, Jian Qian, Benjamin Riviere
papers.evidence: 正则化平均奖励Q学习的有限时间分析
papers.tldr: 平均奖励RL中Bellman算子仅在链混合时按span收缩，现有工作多假设环境混合。本文给定与奖励无关的m步混合策略，向该策略正则化以控制学习策略的收缩与探索，并给出多种正则化下Q-learning的有限时间分析。单步速率匹配已知最优，m步混合得到新速率；Q-planning表现为时间局部化学习，规划长度权衡边界偏差与样本复杂度。框架揭示控制收缩、探索和偏差的正则化依赖量，数值验证α-散度族正则化排序。
papers.abstract_en: The average-reward setting for reinforcement learning is challenging because its Bellman operator is known to contract in span only when the underlying Markov chain is mixing. Whereas existing work typically assumes a contraction property, e.g., through environment mixing, we consider the setting where we are given a reward-agnostic $m$-step mixing policy, and we control the contraction and exploration properties of the learned policy by regularizing toward the mixing policy. We provide finite-time analysis of $Q$-learning algorithms that can be instantiated with multiple choices of regularization, with guarantees measured with respect to the regularized fixed point. Our framework exposes novel regularizer-dependent objects that control contraction, exploration, and operator bias. In the one-step setting, our rates match the best known rates for $Q$-iteration and synchronous $Q$-learning, and for $m$-step mixing we derive new rates. We also study $Q$-planning variants, and show that planning acts as time-localized learning, where the planning horizon $H$ trades off the bias from the boundary value against the sample complexity. Finally, we present numerical studies validating the analysis: (i) knowledge of a strong mixing policy improves convergence and exploration, and its advantage increases with bottleneck severity and, (ii) our theory predicts the convergence and bias rankings of regularizers from the $α$-divergence family.

papers.title_en: RLDISCOVER: LLM-driven co-evolution of reinforcement learning algorithms
papers.authors: Haoran Li, Zengle Ge, Xiaomin Yuan, Yui Lo, Songlin Zhou, Jiahua Ying, Haoxin Li, Qianhui Liu, Yuanhang Liu, Jiaqun Liu, Guokai Chen, Mingju Chen, Ruinan Wang, Annan Li, Jianmin Wu, Dawei Yin, Dou Shen
papers.evidence: 通过LLM引导的程序演化实现无模型深度强化学习算法的自我演化
papers.tldr: LLM引导的程序进化已能发现数学与优化算法，但强化学习算法自我进化受限于耦合组件联合搜索难扩展、候选评估训练昂贵且适应度不确定。RLDiscover以渐进式协同进化和渐进式概率评估，从定向编辑走向联合进化，并用分阶段训练与重复评估平衡搜索广度与保真度。在SAC、PPO、DQN与四个基准上，中位收益提升32%–84%，峰值回报比约363倍，评估算力约为完整评估的1/15，并发现可迁移的可解释组件组合。
papers.abstract_en: LLM-guided program evolution has enabled discoveries in mathematics and computational optimization, raising the prospect of reinforcement learning (RL) algorithms that self-evolve to improve how agents learn. However, realizing this prospect faces two obstacles. Joint search over coupled algorithmic components is difficult to scale: simultaneous changes can disrupt learning, while isolated changes overlook their dependencies. Evaluating candidate algorithms also requires costly training, with fitness remaining uncertain across random seeds. We introduce RLDiscover, a framework for the self-evolution of model-free deep RL algorithms. Progressive Co-Evolution advances from targeted component edits to joint evolution, while Progressive Probabilistic Evaluation balances search breadth and evaluation fidelity through staged training and repeated evaluation. Experiments across SAC, PPO, and DQN on four benchmark suites show substantial improvements in mean return, with per-family median gains of 32%-84% and a peak return ratio of approximately 363x over a near-zero baseline. These gains include transitions from failed learning to successful task completion, and improvements persist when evolution starts from stronger open-source implementations. On measured SAC locomotion runs, evaluation uses approximately one-fifteenth the estimated compute required to fully evaluate the same candidate pool. Remarkably, independent searches repeatedly discover interpretable combinations of adaptive robust losses, progress-dependent value targets, and running statistics, with selected programs transferring to unseen tasks. These findings point toward a broader role for self-evolution in AI: discovering interpretable algorithms that improve how agents learn.

papers.title_en: Safe Learning of Adaptive Control Policies for Remote Patient Monitoring
papers.authors: Ramanan Tamizholi, Siddharth Chandak, Isha Thapa, Nicholas Bambos, David Scheinker
papers.evidence: 在线基于模型强化学习，探索中优先保障安全
papers.tldr: 远程患者监测（RPM）可连续观察患者日常状态，改善健康结局与生活质量，但需在监测强度和患者安全、监测成本之间权衡，且转移概率与成本等系统参数常未知。本文提出一种面向RPM的在线基于模型强化学习框架，实时估计未知参数并自适应调整监测策略，并在探索阶段显式优先保障患者安全。理论上给出安全性与收敛到最优策略的保证；仿真表明算法收敛至最优阈值策略，维持较低治疗成本，并降低患者进入危重健康状态的风险，为安全自适应RPM提供可行方案。
papers.abstract_en: Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM) enables continuous observation of patients in their daily environments, improving both health outcomes and quality of life. A key challenge in RPM is determining the optimal monitoring intensity, while balancing patient safety and monitoring costs. This problem is further complicated when system parameters, such as transition probabilities and costs, are initially unknown. We develop a learning-based control framework that estimates these parameters and adapts the monitoring policy in real time. The proposed approach is an online model-based reinforcement learning algorithm tailored to RPM, with patient safety explicitly prioritized during exploration. We provide theoretical guarantees on safety and convergence to the optimal policy. Simulation results show that the algorithm converges to the optimal threshold-based policy, maintains low treatment costs, and reduces the risk of patients reaching critical health states.

papers.title_en: TAPNAV: Humanoid Navigation through Tactile Active Perception
papers.authors: Huaze Liu, Zhenyu Wu, Jaehwi Jang, Junjie Sheng, Andrew Collins, Aaron Xie, Zhaoyuan Gu, Kaijie Zhu, Ding Jiang, Kevin Cai, Ye Zhao
papers.evidence: 基于触觉主动感知与全身控制的人形机器人导航
papers.tldr: 在无视觉环境中，人形机器人依赖本体里程计会持续漂移，定位不确定性快速累积，导致导航困难。TAPNAV提出触觉主动感知框架，利用里程计、IMU和接触观测维护位姿信念，将不确定性感知的全局路径规划与信息增益驱动的局部探测相结合，并通过全身控制器协调行走和末端接触。在多种户型与障碍几何的仿真和Unitree G1实验中，该方法状态估计误差更低、任务完成率更高。结果表明，主动规划与环境的物理交互可提供定位线索，实现不依赖视觉的可靠人形导航。
papers.abstract_en: Navigation in vision-denied environments is challenging for humanoid robots because proprioceptive odometry drifts and localization uncertainty accumulates rapidly. We present TAPNAV, a tactile active-perception framework that enables humanoid navigation toward a goal by actively probing surrounding structures without relying on vision. TAPNAV maintains a pose belief from odometry, IMU, and tactile contact observations, and couples uncertainty-aware global route planning with information-gain-driven local probing. The global planner searches for routes that keep predicted localization uncertainty bounded by exploiting opportunities for tactile correction, while the local planner selects probe actions that maximize expected information gain. A whole-body controller coordinates the humanoid's locomotion and end-effector contact to execute the planned navigation and probe motions. We evaluate TAPNAV in simulation and on a Unitree G1 across different floor plans and obstacle geometries. TAPNAV achieves lower state estimation error and a higher task completion rate than baselines. These results demonstrate that actively planning physical interactions with the environment can provide localization cues for reliable humanoid navigation without vision.

papers.title_en: Decision-Sufficient Posterior Approximation
papers.authors: Sean Plummer
papers.evidence: 在不确定性下保持下游决策的后验近似
papers.tldr: 论文研究后验近似需保留特定下游决策的问题。以目标后验与损失定义动作的后悔几何，基线近似决定诱导动作变化所需的前向KL信息，受限近似族决定可用变化。通过在贝叶斯动作纤维上收缩KL，得到决策充分与决策失败的精确距离及最省信息变形。局部二阶分析给出后悔Hessian与信息度量的广义特征问题，并区分决策覆盖与信息效率，为比较和设计后验近似族提供决策相对准则。
papers.abstract_en: We investigate the consequences of requiring a posterior approximation to preserve a specified downstream decision problem. A target posterior $P$ and loss determine a regret geometry on actions, a baseline approximation $Q_0$ determines the forward-Kullback-Leibler information required to induce action changes, and a restricted approximation family $\mathcal{Q}$ determines which such changes are available. Contracting KL divergence over Bayes-action fibers gives exact distances to decision adequacy and decision failure together with the least-informative posterior deformations that reach either side of the decision boundary. In regular finite-dimensional problems, the target and baseline constructions have quadratic local limits: a target regret Hessian $G$ and a baseline information metric $J_I$ . Their generalized eigenproblem $Gv = γJ_Iv$ orders local decision directions by regret consequence per unit information cost and induces a tolerance-dependent effective dimension. For restricted approximation families, the tangent image separates decision coverage from information efficiency: a family may miss consequential decision directions, or it may realize reachable directions only at excess Fisher cost. The resulting framework provides decision-relative criteria for comparing and designing posterior approximation families.

papers.title_en: FOCUS: From Privileged States to RGB-D with Controlled Modality Switching and Representation Alignment
papers.authors: Filip Grigorov, Kourosh Darvish, Nandita Vijaykumar
papers.evidence: 面向机器人操作、含特权状态评论家的单阶段PPO框架
papers.tldr: 视觉机器人操作RL因RGB-D高维含噪而样本效率低，仿真特权状态可加速训练但测试时缺失造成模态鸿沟。FOCUS是单阶段PPO框架，用特权状态训练critic，依据两模态动作分布KL散度自动调节actor采集RGB-D或特权状态潜变量并做表征对齐。五个操作任务平均测试成功率从0.71升至0.93，预算归一化AUC从0.47升至0.65；Pick-and-Place成功率从0.47升至0.86，AUC从0.12升至0.61，效率提升5倍。
papers.abstract_en: Vision-based reinforcement learning for robotic manipulation is sample-inefficient because RGB-D observations are high-dimensional and noisy. Privileged state information available in simulation can accelerate training, but its absence at test time creates a train-test modality gap. We propose FOCUS, a single-stage PPO framework that trains the critic on privileged state while automatically regulating whether the actor collects rollouts from RGB-D or privileged-state latents. Regulation is driven by the KL divergence between the action distributions induced by the two modalities, while representation alignment encourages consistent action selection across them. Together, these mechanisms limit RGB-D rollouts when the actor's action distributions from RGB-D and privileged-state latents disagree. As they align, RGB-D exposure increases, shifting on-policy training toward the RGB-D inputs used at test time. Across five manipulation tasks, FOCUS raises average test success from 0.71 to 0.93 relative to the strongest RGB-D-at-test baseline on each task. When accounting for each method's complete training pipeline, budget-normalized training-success AUC increases from 0.47 to 0.65. On Pick-and-Place, test success rises from 0.47 to 0.86, while AUC increases from 0.12 to 0.61, a 5.0x improvement in learning efficiency over the fixed interaction budget.

papers.title_en: Constrained Command-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning with Bandit Strategy Selection in Real-Time Strategy Games
papers.authors: Nick Leenders, Roy Lindelauf, Joost van Oijen, Boris Cule
papers.evidence: 约束命令条件的PPO策略用于策略执行
papers.tldr: 深度强化学习在实时策略游戏中表现强，但面对训练分布外对手时脆弱。为此提出约束命令条件PPO执行器，将战略命令选择与单位控制分离，由Thompson采样bandit作为战略家，依据游戏内观测估计对手策略来选择命令元组。在MicroRTS上与扁平PPO基线对比，对四个最强对手中的三个胜率显著更高，两个最强留出对手胜率从0.55升至0.97、0.01升至0.34，其余无显著差异。表明命令条件执行器结合bandit战略选择可提升鲁棒性与策略复用。
papers.abstract_en: Deep reinforcement learning agents reach strong performance in real-time strategy games but can be brittle against opponents outside their training distribution. Separating strategic command selection from learned unit control allows different strategies to be selected for different opponents while reusing the same execution policy. This requires an executor that can follow different commands and measurable criteria for assessing whether it does so. We introduce a constrained command-conditioned Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) policy, the executor, for MicroRTS, a real-time strategy environment. Discrete commands specify strategic objectives and behavioral requirements for economy, army composition, military posture, and worker policy over multiple environment steps; the executor determines the unit-level actions used to fulfill them. A Thompson-sampling bandit acts as the strategist, selecting command tuples from an estimate of the opponent's strategy built from in-game observations rather than opponent identity. In a controlled comparison with a flat PPO baseline trained with the same architecture, budget, curriculum and self-play league, the strategist-executor system wins significantly more often against three of the four strongest opponents on a training map, including the two strongest held-out ones (0.55 to 0.97 and 0.01 to 0.34), with no significant difference against the others.

papers.title_en: REACT: Rolling Denoising and Dual Decoupling for Reactive Robot Control with VLA Models
papers.authors: Houlong Xiong, Zhenqi Qiu, Zechen Wang, Suohang Zhang, Yiyu Ren, Wanting Xu, Hongfei Niu, Chengyang He, Ge Sun, Ran Cheng, Qian Zhu
papers.evidence: 大型视觉-语言-动作模型通过滚动去噪生成连贯机器人运动
papers.tldr: 基于流的 VLA 模型通过动作分块实现连贯运动，但长分块与频繁重规划在平滑性和反应性之间形成闭环矛盾。REACT 提出滚动去噪框架，维护带错峰流时间步的持久动作缓冲区，每步用最新观测对全时域去噪，执行最干净动作块并前移未来块、尾部补新噪声。它还通过双重解耦分离感知、VLM 编码、DiT 去噪与执行，支持高频更新和动作流式输出。在 RoboTwin 2.0 仿真与多平台真机双臂、动态任务上，REACT 提升成功率、降低反应延迟，轨迹比频繁重规划和异步基线更平滑。
papers.abstract_en: Flow-based vision-language-action (VLA) models generate action chunks for temporally coherent robot motion, but chunked control creates a fundamental closed-loop trade-off: long chunks provide smooth execution, whereas frequent replanning improves reactivity at the cost of action discontinuities. We introduce REACT, a rolling-denoising framework that makes flow-based VLAs more reactive while preserving long-horizon context. Instead of regenerating entire action chunks from scratch, REACT maintains a persistent action buffer with staggered flow timesteps. At each control step, the full horizon is denoised using the latest observation, the cleanest action block is executed, partially refined future blocks are shifted forward, and fresh noise is appended to the tail. As a result, each executed action block is refined across multiple recent observations before deployment. To support real-time control, we further introduce dual decoupling, which separates sensing, VLM encoding, DiT denoising, and action execution, enabling high-frequency observation updates and action streaming under practical compute constraints. Across the RoboTwin 2.0 simulation benchmark and real-world tasks spanning bimanual manipulation and dynamic control on multiple robot platforms, REACT improves task success and reduces reaction latency while producing smoother trajectories than frequent-replanning and asynchronous baselines.
